name: us3-ticket-content
description: US3 rich ticket content (FR-013–FR-018). The reconcile command parses a spec into the neutral document, schema-validates it (a validation failure blocks every write, Constitution VIII), and plans the ordered create/update action set: a ladder title, a never-empty structured description, a Gherkin panel, a distinct Design section, the priority resolved by logical name, and the estimation written on create only. Run as a dry-run so the observable capture is exactly the planned action set (FR-033) — both ports MUST emit a byte-identical set (NFR-1). The reported action URLs are host-relative (the site host is a coordinate that never appears in output, Constitution IV), which also keeps the capture stable across the mock's per-run port.
